title: TRIALMON safety review console
summary: A one-screen safety review of a synthetic first-in-human multiple ascending dose study, CP-101, at its Cohort 4 (120 mg) data cut with 18 dosed participants. Participant, cohort and study-level flags roll up worst-of into one ranked worklist, beside an eDISH liver plot, QTcF categories, CTCAE lab shifts, adverse events by system organ class, a DLT tally against an illustrative 3+3 rule and a study tier with a what-if. The console flags positions for the medical monitor and the Safety Review Committee; it does not adjudicate cases or make a dose-escalation decision.
try: Click a Participant row in the worklist to open that participant's packet in the sidebar.
Open Liver (eDISH) and click a point in the upper-right quadrant to see whether the timing makes it a potential Hy's Law case.
Switch Lab grading between NCI CTCAE v6.0 and v5.0 and watch the lab shifts and the flag counts change.
On Study tier, set an indicator to RED: the overall level re-rolls worst-of, and Reset to the feed undoes it.
